svg.aria-label: Locator map of St Joseph of Cupertino's Italy: Copertino in the Salento, where he was born in a stable in 1603 and lived at the friary of the Grottella; Martina Franca, where the Capuchins received him in 1620; Naples, where he went before the Inquisition in 1638; Rome, where Pope Urban VIII saw him rise in 1639; Assisi, his home from 1639 to 1653; Pietrarubbia and Fossombrone, the hidden Capuchin friaries of 1653 to 1657; and Osimo, where he spent his last years and died in 1663, with Nardò, Lecce, Bari, Taranto, Loreto, Ancona, Perugia, Urbino and Altamura. An inset shows the area within Europe.

g.text: his last years and his tomb, 1657–1663
